name: Mnemosyne (Nabzx)
description: Git-style history for an AI agent's memory (commits, branches, blame, merge), as a command-line tool and Python library, with an MCP server in the repo.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI (mnem) plus Python SDK; MCP server package

offline_no_account.value: Yes: README says local, no network, no model calls

plain_files.value: No: one binary database file; JSON export available

footprint.value: Tiny: one binary and one local database file

claude_code.value: Not named; an MCP server exists for MCP clients

undo_delete.value: Yes: commits keep history; show or checkout past states

outdated_memory.value: Merges stop on clashing edits for you to settle

service_failure.value: No background service documented for the CLI
